'''May 2000 Baton Rouge tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Baton Rouge, Louisiana on 6 May 2000. [[Robert Rau]] won it. It is known from Karl Schultz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d674">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-baton-rouge-louisiana-5-6-00d674/ baton-rouge-louisiana-5-6-00], DeckTech (Karl "Faust" Schultz, 6 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-baton-rouge-louisiana-5-6-00d674/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Baton Rouge, Louisiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 6
* '''Winner:''' [[Robert Rau]]
